title: Curvature estimate for the heteroclinical solution to a Bose-Einstein condensation system
summary: We investigate heteroclinical solutions of a vector-valued Bose-Einstein condensation system involving the $p$-Laplacian. The main difficulty comes from the degeneracy of the $p$-Laplacian and the possible nonsmooth behavior of the potential wells. Under suitable assumptions on the double-well potential, we establish the existence and detailed asymptotic behavior of heteroclinical solutions.
